# Lab 13.5: AI.SCORE & AI.CLASSIFY

## What We Are Going to Do
Rank reviews with AI.SCORE and route news articles into your own categories with AI.CLASSIFY.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Top 5 most positive reviews.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title, review,
  AI.SCORE(('Rate how positive this review is, from 1 (very negative) to 10 (very positive): ', review)) AS positivity
FROM lab13.reviews
ORDER BY positivity DESC
LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Classify articles into custom labels.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  AI.CLASSIFY(body, categories =&gt; ['technology', 'sport', 'business', 'politics', 'entertainment']) AS ai_category,
  category AS original_category,
  COUNT(*) AS articles
FROM (SELECT body, category FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext` LIMIT 200)
GROUP BY ai_category, original_category
ORDER BY articles DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Compare `ai_category` with the original category to check quality.

3. **[SQL] Route support tickets.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT * FROM UNNEST([
    'My card was charged twice for one order',
    'The app crashes when I open my cart',
    'Where is my parcel? It is 5 days late',
    'How do I change my delivery address?'
  ]) AS ticket
)
SELECT ticket, AI.CLASSIFY(ticket, categories =&gt; ['billing', 'technical', 'delivery', 'account']) AS team
FROM tickets;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `AI.SCORE` | Number used in `ORDER BY` |
| `AI.CLASSIFY` | One of your labels |
| Use in `GROUP BY` | Counts per AI label |
| Model choice | Made by BigQuery for these managed functions |
